Made with Natural Earth

The Statistics maps use a derived, rounded version of Natural Earth's
1:110m admin 0 map units. Natural Earth vector and raster map data is
in the public domain. Permission and attribution are not required.

Source: https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector
Pinned commit: 9380cca83db5f9aef52d5e762765100745f84b27
File: geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_map_units.geojson
Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

Modifications: projected to a compact plate carree SVG view, coordinates
rounded to one decimal place, adjacent duplicate coordinates removed,
map units grouped by ISO_A2_EH, Antarctica omitted. No runtime mapping
library or remote map service is included.

This low-resolution map is illustrative. Small territories may not have
a visible shape. The location list remains authoritative for the counts.
Boundaries do not imply a position on sovereignty or disputed areas.
